TRUST LABEL, HARD TERM. English: a maintainer signed this patch into the project's history (it is NOT a verification result, so it must not read as 検証済み). The draft says both parts: signed + recorded in the history. Alternatives: 履歴に署名済み / 署名済み / 署名して履歴に取り込み済み.
TRUST LABEL. prikk checked and found problems (it does NOT mean "was not checked"). 検証に失敗 = the verification failed.

TRUST LABEL. Shown only where a verification ran and passed (the repository, history and verification pages): prikk ran all of its checks just now and found no problems. HARD TERM 検証. Does 検証済み read as a lasting guarantee? It must mean "verified just now".
TRUST LABEL. The check could not run (an outage, a limit, a timeout); it did NOT fail. 確認 rather than 検証 so that nothing claims a verification happened.
